tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bsnyen pa ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ 'dir dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bsnyen pa ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa ni/ dang por gnas yid dang mthun par ji srid mtshams kyi bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar du/ dgra'i 'jigs pa la sogs pa mtshams glo bur du 'grol dgos pa'i rkyen mi 'byung ba'i sar/ dang por zhag 'ga' skyabs 'gro sems skyed la nan tan bya zhing*/ de nas kyang zla ba gcig gnyis sam ma mtha' zhag bcu tsam du yi ge brgya pa nyid ci nus su bgrong*/ /phyag dang bskor ba la sogs pa chos spyod 'grub tshad bya/ de nas skyabs sems sngon du song ba'i sgo nas/ rang bde mchog phyag gnyis par lam gyi gsal btab/ sum+bha'i sngags ci 'grub tu bzlas zhing thun mtshams su bla ma'i gsol 'debs nan tan du 'bad par bya/ rim pa de khas/ rab sum+bha 'bum phrag bzhi/ 'bring 'bum/ ma mtha'ang bzhi khri song nas yang gzhan 'dra ba la/ phur gdab kyi sngags kho na zhag bdun las mi nyung ba drag tu bzla/ de yan chad ni bsnyen pa'i dkyus thogs kyi mgo yin na rab bsnyen pa dang de'i bar du dus gzhan gyi bar chod kyang 'gal ba med cing*/ thun gyi skabs ngag bcad bya/ mtshams bya dgos pa'i nges pa med/ de nas bde mchog gi rnal 'byor pa yin na rab/ min na'ang rnal 'byor pa bzhir longs pa'am dge slong bzhir longs pa la tshogs bsags dang ston mo bya bsnyen pa mthar phyin zhing bar chad mi 'ong bar smon lam btab/ bla ma la yon 'bul ba dang*/ lha khang du mchod pa 'bul ba sogs byas nas/ bar chad mi 'byung zhing dngos grub thob par gsol ba 'debs/ de yan chad ni bsnyen sgrub byed pa'i gnas de ma yin pa gzhan du byas kyang rung ngo*/ /de nas sgrub khang gi phyi rol du tho rtsig de yang phyogs bzhir tho dngos ma 'grub na mtshon byed re bya/ shar gyi tho yul 'khor bsrung*/ lho 'phags skyes po/ nub mig mi bzang*/ byang rnam thos sras rnams su skad cig gis bskyed/

ri rab kyi bang rim nas rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor bcas spyan drangs mchod bstod bya/ bstod pa ni 'di ltar/ rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa/ /margad mdog can pi wang 'dzin/ /dri za'i tshogs la dbang sgyur ba'i/ /yul 'khor bsrung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo chen po stobs po che/ kha dog sngon po ral gri 'dzin/ grul bum tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /'phags skyes po la phyag 'tshal lo/ mnga' bdag chen po mthu bo che/ kha dog dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /klu yi tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /mig mi bzang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ded dpon chen po gser mdog can/ /be con dang ni ne'u le 'dzin/ /gnod sbyin tshogs la dbang sgyur ba'i/ /rnam thos sras la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'o/ /mchod pa dang gtor ma re bshams la/ gtor chog ltar byin gyis rlabs nas/ shar gyi la oṃ dhi dha raṣ+ta ya sa pa ri wa ra/ zhes pa la/ ā ka ro btags te lan gsum gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs kyi 'dod don gsol ba btab/ khyad par du sgrub pa ma thon gyi bar du bar chad zhi ba'i 'phrin las bcol/ gzhan 'dra ba las/ lhor bi ru ḍhā ka ye sa pa ri zhes sogs dang*/ nub tu mig mi bzang la bi ru pak+ṣa ye/ byang du bai shra ba ṇa ye zhes 'don pa spo/ su pra ti ṣ+ṭha'i sngags kyi brtan bzhugs lan mang du bya/ phyis mkha' 'gro spyi gtor 'bul ba'i skabs su yang rgyal chen bzhi po re la zur bsngos tsam bya/ de phyin chad tho phyir mi 'gro/ zhag 'ga'i bar du yi ge brgya pa nyid bsgrong zhing*/ thun mtshams bzhir 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma lan re re phul nas/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gang mang 'bul/ bar chad mi 'byung zhing dngos grub bcol bar gsol ba mang du btab/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor mang du 'bul tshul ni lan ji tsam 'bul ba'i grangs dang mthun pa'i mtheb kyu byas la/

dang por thams cad phyogs gcig tu byin gyis brlabs te 'bul ba'i tshe/ mtheb kyu re sgron/ sngags lan res phul la/ gsol gdab re bya/ thams cad rdzogs pa na mchod bstod gsol btab rgyas pa bya/ de nas zhag 'ga' shas kyi bar du/ thun gyi skabs rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i gsol 'debs la 'bad/ thun mtshams gtor ma sngar dang 'dra/ de nas phur bu bcu yod na de rnams kyi mtha' ma mchod gtor gyis bskor sgo mtshams ma brgyad dang*/ slar yang khwa gdong khyi gdong gnyis te bcu po lte ba man chad phur bu'i rnam pa can du bskyed/ phaiṃ gyis ye shes pa spyan drangs dbang bskur rgyas btab bya/ phur pa re re bzhin du sgo mtshams ma so so'i sngags phreng skor re dang*/ spyi khyab tu sum+bha brgya rtsa brgyad phur btab kyi sngags ci rigs dang bcas pa bzla/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te/ rang rang gi sngags mthar ā ka ro btags te 'bul/ mchod bstod/ bgegs phur bus 'debs pa dang*/ bsnyen pa ma grol bar du bar chad bsrung ba'i 'phrin las bcol/ dmigs pa bsrung 'khor bzhin du bgegs 'gugs pa sogs byas te/ phyogs so sor phur btab dang*/ phur bu brdung ba'i sngags lan gsum gsum gyis phyogs so so'i bgegs la phur bus 'debs/ de yang sgrub khang gi phyogs bcur phur bu'i bzhugs khang yod na/ der phur btab byas la bzhugs su gsol/ med na sgrub khang gi phyogs mtshams kyi thog gam zur la btags/ gal te phur pa bcu ma 'dzom na/ brgyad la sgo mtshams ma brgyad du bskyed de shar gyi steng du yang gdab pa dang*/ 'og tu yang nub kyi de ka gdab bo/ phur bu bzhi las med na/ shar shar lho/ lho lho nub/ nub nub byang*/ byang byang shar rnams re rer bsdoms kyang chog /mthar phyogs bzhir bzhugs su gsol/ phur bu gcig las med na/ de nyid steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du gdab ste mthar sgrub khang gi sgo gong la btags/

gang ltar yang phur gdab grub pa dang*/ sgrub khang gi dkyil du mchod gtor bshams la/ byin rlabs grub pa dang*/ phur bu'i lha rnams la phul/ bgegs thams cad bsrung bar gsol ba btab/ rten 'brel snying po dang*/ su pra tiṣ+ṭhas brtan bzhugs bya/ oṃ mi dhi ni badz+ri bha ba sogs bsrung 'khor gyi sngags tshan drug po re re bzhin lan mang du brjod pas/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi la sogs pa mi phyed cing brtan par gyur pa bsam/ de ltar phur btab nyi ma phyi dro zhig gi skabs su bya ste/ de nub nas gzung mtshams dam du bcad do/ /de phyin chad nyer mkho mtshams 'og tu thog ma nas bcug pa rnams ma gtogs mi gsar pa dang mi 'phrad spyad pa gsar pa nang du mi btang*/ zhag 'ga'i bar du mngon rtogs yongs su rdzogs pa bsgoms la/ sngags cung zad re bzla/ bsrung 'khor tshar re bsgoms la/ sum+bha lan brgya skor re drag tu bzla/ de 'dra nyin re bzhin tshar bcu drug nyi shu tsam bya ba dang*/ ma mtha' yang brgyad re bya'o/ /da bar du ngag bcad sogs dam po mi bya'o/ /de nas bsnyen pa dngos la 'jug ste/ 'dzin gtor nang mchod dang bcas pa bshams/ gtor ma bshams ma thag bsrung ba byed pa gal che/ thun gyi thog mar sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlab pa re grub na legs te/ sngon du nang mchod byin rlabs bya/ ma grub na/ rdor sems sgom bzlas kyi rjes la nang mchod byin rlabs bya/ de nas mngon rtogs kyi rim pa rnams la tshig shar du ma song bar/ tshig 'don pa dang de dang de'i don sgom pa sbrags te bya/ bzlas pa'i man ngag dus rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la dkyil 'khor bsdus te/ rang zhal phyag yongs rdzogs kyi nga rgyal gyis bzlas pa byed pa'ang rung mod kyi/ bsnyen pa'i skabs 'dir dkyil 'khor ma bsdus par mdzad do/ /thog mar sum+bha lan bdun/ de nas rtsa sngags sogs len re tsam byas la/ bsnyen pa gang byed de la ci 'grub bzlas/

mjug tu 'khor rnams la lan re dang*/ sum+bha ci rigs bzlas la rjes bsdu ba bya/ gang ltar lus dkyil gyi gtso bo snying ga'i bde mchog gi thugs kar sngags phreng 'god pa/ sems dpa' gsum brtsegs kyi lugs sam/ yang na lus dkyil gyi gtso bo'i mdun phyogs su sgom stabs bde na'ang rung ste/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las ji ltar bzla ba'i sngags kyi phreng ba gcig phreng ma chad par byung ba rang gi rtsa zhal nas 'thon/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud nas pad+mar son/ rang gi rdo rje'i lam nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ slar thugs ka'i hūṃ la thim/ yang sngags phreng byung ba sogs de nyid rtag tu bsam/ yang na hūṃ las sngags phreng byung*/ rang gi sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas 'thon pa pad+ma nas zhugs/ yum gyi sku'i dbyibs brgyud zhal nas 'thon/ rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūṃ la thim par sgom kyang rung ste/ de yang dang pos bying ba sel/ phyi mas rgod pa sel zhing*/ snga ma sgoms pas ro stod na ba dang*/ dbugs 'tshang ba dang*/ shes pa 'phyo ba sogs byung na/ phyi ma 'di sgoms pas gegs sel du yang 'gyur/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ snga mas rdzogs rim gyi skabs srog thur sel la 'dre ba dang*/ phyi mas thur sel srog la bsre ba'i smin byed yang dag par 'gyur zhing*/ da lta sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pas/ de dus bgegs mi 'byung ba yin gsung ngo*/ /dus rgyun gyi bsnyen pa'i skabs/ yig 'bru'i mdog lha'i sku mdog dang mtshungs shing*/ myur dal ran por 'gro ba sgoms pas kyang rung*/ las bzhi sgrub pa'i skabs/ dus gnad dang bstun te zhi ba la dkar po mda'i shugs tsam gyis myur bar 'gro ba dang*/ rgyas pa la ser po sgro chun gyi tshul gyis 'gro ba dang*/ dbang la dmar po lcags sgrog gi tshul gyis 'gro ba dang*/ drag po la nag po srad bu sgril pa'i tshul gyis 'gro ba yin te/

dpe don zhal las shes par bya'o/ /gzhan yang spro bsdu'i bzlas pa dang*/ bkod pa'i bzlas pa la sogs pa bzlas pa'i rnam grangs mang po rnams kyang ci rigs par bya ba yin mod kyi/ gtso bor gong du bstan pa'i do li'am khyogs kyi bzlas pa la byed pa de nyid phyag len yin/ gang ltar sngags 'khor ba'i tshe/ yig 'bru re re bzhin du rang rang gis sgra rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba dang*/ zhal bzhi kas sngags bzla zhing*/ 'khor drug bcu po thams cad kyis kyang sngags bzla grogs mdzad pa dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems/ yul nyer bzhi'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyang rang la byin gyis rlob pa'i don du thams cad kyang mdun gyi nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs te/ sngags bzla grogs mdzad cing byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ dmigs pa rgya che na ni sems can thams cad kyang he ru ka'i go 'phang la bkod de/ de thams cad kyis kyang sngags bzlas par bsam/ gang ltar skad che chung myur bul sogs kyi skyon med pa sems gzhan du ma yengs par 'don/ thun mtshams re re bzhin gtor ma 'grub na legs/ ma grub na srod kyi tha mar gtor ma phul/ thun mtshams su ngag bcad ma grub kyang dgag bya chung zhing*/ zas nam bza' yang*/ phud gtor ma'i tshul gyi 'bul ba dang*/ rang lhar bsam nas thugs kar dkyil 'khor bsgoms nas bza' ba ma chag pa gal che/ thun mtshams thams cad du dgos med kyi gtam mi smra/ lha skur lam gyis ldang ba dang sngags yang yang bzla/ de bar nyin re bzhin sngags 'di tsam ma song na rung ba med snyam pa'i 'tshab bya chen po de bar chad du 'gro bas/ brgya stong tsam gyi mtho dman la bsgrig pa nges bzung mi bya ba'i de nas 'gro gang che bya/ thun grangs ni bshad tshod thun bzhi bshad cing*/ nam gyi gung thun gyi tha mar gtor ma 'bul bar gsungs/ phyag len la ni sna tshogs yod cing gtso bor tho rangs nas nyin phyed yan chad snga thun dang*/

phyi dro nas srod yan chad du phyi thun du byas te/ thun gnyis su mdzad pa sngags 'gro che bas de ltar mdzad do/ /yid mi bde skyes na blo dpangs gtong*/ 'jig rten gyi rnam rtog la yengs na snying po med tshul dran par bya/ mdor na yi dam myur du 'grub pa cig bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa shugs drag po cig yod na byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa yin no/ /bsnyen pa dngos gzhi tshugs pa nas/ thun ngag bcad kyi skabs su gang song de bsnyen grangs su 'dren/ thun mtshams su bzla ba de bar chad zhi ba dang*/ byin rlabs rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phyir yin gyi bsnyen pa'i grangs su mi 'dren/ rtsub 'gyur cung zad byung na bsrung 'khor drag tu sgom zhing*/ sum+bha mang du bzla/ des kyang ma sel na/ mtho sgron pa dang*/ mchod gtor phul la/ slar yang sngar bzhin phur btab bya/ bsrung 'khor sgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ sum+bha'i bsnyen pa zhag 'ga' re byas pas nges par sel bar 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi bsnyen pa bya ba'i tshe/ gtso bo'i bcu cha 'khor rnams la bzla dgos pa phyag len mi 'dra ba sna tshogs 'dug na'ang*/ thog mar gtso bo'i bsnyen pa ma song bar/ 'khor rnams la mi bzla bar gtso bo nyid la dril/ 'khor gyi skabs kyang gang la bsnyen pa bya ba de nyid kyi sngags ma song bar du/ gzhan rnams bzla ba'i spros pa dor te/ de dang de tshig 'dril du byed pa nyid legs par snang ngo*/ /'khor gyi sngags bzla dus zhal bzhis bzla ba sogs spyi dang 'dra ba la rang gi thugs kar gtso bo'i sngags g.yon skor du bkod de'i 'od lha de'i thugs kar phog pas de'i thugs rgyud bskul bar bsams la bzla/ de'i thugs kar yang de'i sngags bkod nas/ de la 'od phog par bsam pa'ang spro na bya'o/ /rnal 'byor ma so bdun la bzla tshul gzhan yang yod do/ /bsnyen pa grol nas mkha' 'gro ma la gtang rag gi mchod gtor rgya cher 'bul/

sbyin sreg kyang dkyus thog de nyid la 'grub na shin tu legs/ bsnyen pa ma grol gyi bar lha gang gi bsnyen pa byed pa yin gzhan sus kyang ma shes par bya/ bsnyen pa'i skor gyi dang po'i bya ba rnams 'go 'dzug pa dang*/ bsnyen pa dngos gzhi la 'jug pa dang*/ grol ba rnams rnam rtog dang rjes su 'brel ba rnams gza' tshes shis pa re la mdzad par snang ngo*/ /bskyed rim gyi 'khrid ni/ sbyangs gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod nas sgom tshul dang*/ bskyed rim gyi sems 'dzin gyi rnam gzhag rgyas pa gzhan du bris zin pa dang*/ 'dir yi ge mang bar 'gyur pas mi 'bri la/ dmigs thun gyi rkang grangs ni/ dkyil 'khor bsdus nas rang nyid zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan par byas la sems 'dzin/ yang mngon rtogs rgyas pa mi sgom pa'i rigs la ni/ skyabs sems dang yig brgya song ba'i rjes su/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje chos dmar po rdo rje skyil krung can/ ḍā ma ru dang thod pa khwa ṭ+waṃ ga 'dzin pa he ru ka'i rnam pa can du gsal btab nas dbang bzhi len pa'i tshul bya/ bdag bla mas dkyil 'khor du bcug phyin/ phyi ni bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ nang rtsa khams ni lha drug bcu rtsa gnyis yin snyam du bya/ zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis par lam gyi gsal btab nas sems 'dzin gang ltar yang thog mar thor cog kyi rtse mo'i nor bu la sems 'dzin pa dmigs skor gcigayang na thog mar phyag sen dmar po 'od 'phro ba la sems 'dzin pa'ang yod/ de nas thor cog dang bcas pa'i rtsa zhal la gcig /de bzhin du zhal lhag ma gsum po la yang re re/ sku byings la gcig /phyag bcu gnyis la g.yas g.yon gnyis bsdom du byas la thun drugazhabs g.yon gdan dang bcas pa la gcig /de bzhin du g.yas la'ang gcigan bza' rgyan dang bcas pa la gcig /slar sku yongs su rdzogs pa la cig car sems 'dzin pa ste bcu drug go

/nga rgyal la slab pa la/ rang nyid dpal he ru ka dngos yin snyam pa rags par slab pa la gcig /rang gi ming rus sogs kyi rnam rtog ched kyis spangs te/ lha'i nga rgyal tsam la slob pa dang gnyis/ skyon kun zad yon tan kun rdzogs kyi he ru ka nga yin/ he ru ka'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan thams cad nga la yod do/ /de'i phyir nga he ru ka'o zhes nga rgyal brtan po bskyed de/ de nyid yun ring du skyangs pa ste gsum mo/ /slar yang nga rgyal dang gsal snang de nyid kyi steng du rang bzhin ma bcos pa'i tshul gyi mnyam par 'jog pa'ang 'grub na bya ste zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i tshul du 'gyur ro/ / yang bskyed rim gyi lha sku la dmigs shing des nye bar mtshon pa'i chos thams cad gcig du bral dang*/ rten 'byung gi rigs pa sogs la brten nas snang ba ltar rang bzhin ma grub pa'i tshul la dmigs nas gsal stong du bsgom mo/ / 'di yang las dang po pa zhi gnas phyogs mthun tsam yang ma grub cing*/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i sgom gyi 'jug sgo tsam yang ma shar ba ji snyed cig 'byung ba rnams la ches phan par 'gyur ba'i thabs mkhas zab mo yin pas/ rdo rje slob dpon chen po grub chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi zhal snga nas sgrub pa'i thabs kun tu bzang po las shin tu rgyas pa che thang du gsungs pa dang*/ de'i dgongs 'grel gyi 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs tshad dang ldan pa mtha' yas pa zhig las bshad pas/ gang dag gsang sngags kyi lugs la rnam par mi rtog pa 'ba' zhig yin zhes smra ba de dag ni/ bdag nyid legs par ma slabs bzhin du mtha' yas pa'i sems can sgrol bar mdzad pa'i dam pa rnams la so so skye bo ci yang ma sgoms shing*/ sde snod dang rgyud sde ma slabs pa'i blun po 'ga' zhig gi skur pa 'debs pa'i tshig tsam zhig gi rjes su 'brangs nas/ snying nas smod pa'i las ngan pa gsog pa tsam du zad kyi/ lung rigs kyi sgrub byed sna gcig med par ma zad/

gsang sngags rdzogs rim gyi skabs su bden med kyi 'dun pa sbyong ba sogs rang lugs dang yang 'gal ba yin no/ /yang 'ga' zhig las dang po'i skabs su rnam par mi rtog pa'i phyag rgya chen po nan gyi 'gog pa de dag ni shin tu mi 'thad mod kyi/ lung rig du ma'i sgo nas gzhan du bkag zin te/ /des na grong khyer chen po'i sgo nas 'gro na nub sgo kho na nas 'jug dgos pa'i phyogs lhung gi grub mtha' ngan pa 'di ma 'dzin zhig ces gdams ngag tu bya'o/ /rnam pa thams cad du rnam rtog gi 'jug pa can gyi dpyad sgom 'gog na ni/ byams pa dang snying rje dang*/ bla ma la mos gus dang*/ dkon mchog yid la sgom pa dang*/ lha sku sgom pa rnams kyang rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa ma skyes bar du sgom du mi rung bar mi 'gyur ram/ de rnams rung na stong pa nyid kyi dpyad pa gcig pus ci nyes/ dam bca' tsam ma yin pa'i sgrub byed dang 'gog byed yod na smos shig dang*/ slar yang 'thag par bya'o//smras pa/ bdag nyid nyams nas gzhan dag kyang*/ /bslu bar byed pa gang de blun/ /rang nyid grol nas gzhan dag kyang*/ /grol bar byed pa gang de mkhas/ /zhes 'khor lo sgom pa'i bsnyen pa'i man ngagabla med kyi rgyud sde thams cad la nye bar phan pa 'di yang*/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i lam la lhag par mos pa'i dge ba can/ mdo khams rgyal thang pa dge slong kun dga' ye shes dang shar rong ba dge slong chos kyi rgyal pos bskul nas rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer drug pa tha skar gyi zla ba'i tshes bcu gnyis la smras pa'o/ /shu bhaṃ ma stu sarba dzā ga taṃ/ zhus dag /dge legs 'phel// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bsnyen pa ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa bzhugs/ -PAGE 340--PAGE 339--PAGE 329-
